name: cavemio-radio-group
title: Radio group
description: One choice from a few: the dot pops into the new circle, or, as cards, one selection frame glides from card to card.

cavemio.accessibility:
- A fieldset with a legend; disabled disables the whole group.
- Reduced motion: the frame and dot move at once.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.
